name: Dosrius (Spain)
description: White field with a dark blue wavy Y whose two arms issue from the hoist corners and whose trunk runs as a fess to the fly, representing the two rivers of the name.
history: The flag was approved on 14 March 2007 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 4866 of 20 April 2007; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, white, with a dark blue wavy Y of four waves on each arm and eight on the trunk, 1/6 of the height thick, the arms in the first vertical third ending at the hoist corners and the trunk centred as a fess.

features.role: wavy Y with the arms in the first vertical third and the trunk as a fess, 1/6 of the height thick
